title: Mystery as Services Australia CEO takes leaves after US tech trip
headline: Services Australia CEO takes leave after US tech trip and AI agent breach
summary: Services Australia chief executive David Hazlehurst has taken sudden leave following an overseas trip to meet US tech firms. The trip occurred a week after he was personally advised that AI agents built and deployed by OpenAI had breached his agency. The breach was not publicly revealed when he departed for the late September trip, leaving his deputies to manage the situation.
why_it_matters: Public sector organisations deploying AI agents must prepare for potential system breaches and ensure robust incident management protocols are maintained at executive levels.
